Day 18 (old art) - December 2015 (age 13)

looks like my edgy phase paused for a bit to draw something colorful and "happy" as well as some hand gestures~

if I may be candid, I was going through a really rough time back then and both horror and colorful happy drawings were a sincere coping mechanism (and still are)

yet another example of art holding a piece of the artists soul, even if it may not be apparent to the viewer without context

please be kind to artists, especially younger ones

you never know what someone is struggling with
